verdict.rationale: stagewise documents a first-party GitHub plugin that gives the agent access to issues and pull requests. Its agent can also read and edit files, run shell commands and orchestrate multi-step workflows, so the pieces for going from an issue to a PR exist inside the product. However, no documented end-to-end issue-to-PR flow is shown, and the GitHub integration is only a single-line mention. Missing for 10: a documented workflow that turns an issue into a PR, details on PR creation and branch/commit handling, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
